title: Exercise folder metadata (meta.json) for practice/ and ladder/ exercises

id.description: practice: <paper>:<q> of the main leaf, e.g. 9618_s24_22:2(b); ladder: L05/E03

rows.description: Row ids covered by this exercise

adapted_from.description: Ladder only: attribution, e.g. 'CS50P Problem Set 2 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), adapted'

pseudocode.description: True when the learner must first answer in Cambridge pseudocode (answer.pseudo)

files.description: Data files under files/ the program reads (copied from official source files for P4)

entry.description: Optional: name of the function/class the tests target, or 'main' for script-style tasks

ms_verified.description: True only when tests/markpoints derive from the exact matching MS
